name: @veren/admin-audit-default
description: Use when a DSH admin deployment needs the append-only audit capability backed by the shared data port: it appends entries with generated ids and UTC timestamps, trims by entry cap and retention window without dropping a newer row before an older one, serves filtered newest-first pages with opaque cursors, and exposes GET /api/admin/v1/audit; skip it when the deployment only needs the audit contract types or already ships a different audit provider.
